settings.content: The animated DUNAS logo screen. Visitors can end it at any time with a tap, click, scroll or key press. It never shows inside the theme editor; preview your store to see it.

settings.info: Home page: plays each time someone opens the home page, never on other pages. Once per visit: plays on the first page someone opens, then not again until their next visit.
